en.hubeali: A number or our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Mansour Bin Al Abbas, from Ibn Mayyah, from his father who said,
‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The one who wants the leadership, is destroyed!’.
en.sarwar: 7. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Mansur ibn al- ‘ Abbas from ibn Mayyah from his father who has said the following: “
I heard abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) saying, ‘Whoever wants leadership is destroyed.’”
